Manager Product Development - Tieto Caretech (m/f/d)

About Us



- Tieto Caretech is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. We develop and deliver high-quality software solutions and services that enable healthcare and welfare professionals to do their work even better and with higher efficiency - have more time to care.
- We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors from intensive care to laboratory and social care. In addition to working closely with our customers, we also have our own products that we build and develop for various fields in society. From enabling healthcare professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients to providing data for professional athletes to achieve even better results, we make all that possible. With us you can build technology for the good of society and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people in need.

Experience level: 18+ Years

Position Summary



- We are seeking a highly skilled Product Development Manager who represents Agile Leadership principles and practices. This role requires a strong technical background combined with exceptional leadership skills. The role is expected to lead team members and managers; drive product development excellence, and enable teams to adopt modern engineering practices, including AI-enabled ways of working.

Key Responsibilities



- Lead, mentor, and develop cross-functional engineering teams in delivering high-quality software products.
- Lead and coach managers/team leads, ensuring effective leadership practices, accountability, and consistent execution across teams.
- Act as a second-line manager with responsibility for multiple teams, including managers reporting into this role.
- Drive technical decision-making and architecture design for complex systems.
- Collaborate with product owners to translate business requirements into technical specifications.
- Implement and optimize development processes to improve efficiency and product quality.
- Drive adoption of AI-assisted software development practices, including responsible use of AI tools for coding, testing, documentation, analysis, and productivity improvement.
- Ensure AI usage follows company policies, security, compliance, data privacy, and ethical guidelines.
- Manage the entire product lifecycle, from conception to deployment and maintenance.
- Attract, recruit, induct, and retain capable technical personnel and managers.
- Evaluate performance, including team and manager input; provide guidance and corrective actions.
- Participate in defining and administering compensation, benefits, and promotions.
- Perform career coaching and personal development for team members, managers, and future leaders.
- Set priorities across teams to ensure task completion, alignment, and project success.
- Support teams and managers in problem identification, root cause analysis, and decision-making.
- Eliminate technical and organizational impediments to team productivity.
- Manage full financial responsibility for own profit unit.
- Establish short- and mid-term technical plans in cooperation with the management team.
- Participate in product strategy creation and communicate targets clearly across teams.
- Foster an environment that supports cooperation among work teams and with other areas of the organization.
- Balance hands-on technical involvement with empowering managers and teams to problem-solve independently.
- Act as a role model for company values, Lean-Agile Leadership, technical excellence, and continuous learning.
- Handle products in the maintenance phase, including managing client escalations, critical issues/tickets, and urgent fixes.
- Effectively collaborate with product owners, onsite teams/leaders, managers, and technical support personnel.
- Establish and follow Agile ways of working, ensuring continuous improvement of development processes
- Build a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, accountability, and responsible AI adoption.

Required Skills



- Strong technical background with past hands-on coding experience.
- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
- Proven track record of delivering complex software projects on time and within budget.
- Strong communication skills, both technical and non-technical.
- Experience in stakeholder management and client-facing roles.
- Ability to balance technical leadership with people management responsibilities.
- Proven experience in managing managers, team leads, or multiple engineering teams.
- Ability to build leadership capability within teams and enable managers to take ownership.
- Good understanding of AI/GenAI trends, tools, and their practical application in software development and product engineering.
- Ability to drive responsible AI adoption while considering quality, security, compliance, and business impact.

Technical Requirements



- Extensive experience with full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), including requirements gathering, design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
- Proficiency in Agile methodologies such as Scrum, Kanban, and SAFe, with experience leading Agile teams at scale.
- Strong knowledge of modern software development practices, including CI/CD, DevOps, and cloud technologies.
- Past hands-on experience with one or more programming languages, for example .NET, C#, Java, Python, C++, or JavaScript.
- Familiarity with microservices architecture, RESTful APIs, and distributed systems.
- Experience with database technologies, including SQL and NoSQL.
- Understanding of software testing methodologies and quality assurance processes.
- Knowledge of version control systems such as Git and issue tracking tools such as JIRA.
- Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering tools and practices, such as AI coding assistants, automated test generation, code review support, documentation generation, and AI-enabled productivity improvements.
- Understanding of data security, privacy, compliance, and governance considerations related to AI usage in software development.
- Awareness of AI/ML concepts, GenAI capabilities, LLM-based solutions, and their relevance to product development and customer-facing solutions

What’s in it for you?

In addition, as a company we offer you professional growth, open and friendly culture. We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working.

Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle. We want to encourage you to keep up that curiosity and deepen your knowledge on topics you’re interested in.

Could you be our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the Recruiter.

About Tieto

Tieto creates purposeful technology that reinvents the world for good. We are a leading technology company with a strong Nordic heritage and global capabilities. Based on our core values of openness, trust and diversity, we work with our customers to develop digital futures where businesses, societies, and humanity thrive.

Our 24,000 experts globally specialize in cloud, data, and software, serving thousands of enterprises and public-sector customers in more than 90 countries. Tieto’s annual turnover is approximately EUR 3 billion, and the company’s shares are listed on the NASDAQ exchange in Helsinki and Stockholm, as well as on Oslo Børs.

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

Role: Advanced Specialist, Product Management
  

Location: Bangalore (On-site)
  

We are seeking a customer‑centric Product Manager to lead product management for Credly and its enterprise integration ecosystem within Pearson’s ELS portfolio. This role focuses on scaling and evolving Credly as a platform product , enabling seamless integrations with learning, talent, and assessment systems used by enterprise and institutional customers.
  

This is a highly cross‑functional product role, working at the intersection of platform capabilities, API‑driven integrations, and enterprise customer needs . You will partner closely with engineering, architecture, UX, commercial, and customer success teams to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable integrations that drive adoption and business value.
  

The role is ideal for a Product Manager who thrives in B2B / B2B2C environments , understands platform and integration products , and can translate complex technical capabilities into clear customer value propositions.
  

Key Responsibilities
  


- Own the product vision and roadmap for Credly’s integrations and platform capabilities, aligned to ELS and broader Pearson strategy.
  

- Define and prioritise APIs, partner integrations, and platform features that enable Credly to integrate seamlessly with LMS, HRIS, talent, and assessment ecosystems.
  

- Partner with enterprise customers, internal stakeholders, and partners to understand integration requirements, workflows, and constraints.
  

- Collaborate closely with engineering, platform architecture, and security teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and compliant integration solutions.
  

- Work with UX and design to ensure simple, intuitive experiences for administrators, partners, and developers.
  

- Lead and contribute to a cross‑functional delivery squad , ensuring product outcomes are delivered with quality and predictability.
  

- Use data, customer insights, and adoption metrics to inform prioritisation and iteration .
  

- Support go‑to‑market and commercial teams by providing product input for customer conversations, solution positioning, and sales enablement.
  

- Communicate a clear and compelling product narrative that articulates Credly’s platform value, integration strategy, and enterprise impact.
  

Candidate Profile
  

Experience & Qualifications
  


- 4+ years of product management experience , preferably working on platform, integration, or SaaS products .
  

- Demonstrated experience working closely with engineering and technical teams , including API‑first or integration‑heavy products.
  

- Experience managing complex stakeholder environments , including enterprise customers, partners, and internal teams.
  

- Strong understanding of B2B or B2B2C product delivery models.
  

- Ability to navigate ambiguity, balance competing priorities, and make informed trade‑offs.
  

Skills & Strengths
  


- Strong customer‑focused mindset , with the ability to translate enterprise needs into clear product outcomes.
  

- Comfortable working on platform capabilities rather than purely end‑user features .
  

- Excellent communication and storytelling skills , able to align technical and non‑technical audiences.
  

- Analytical and data‑informed, with a focus on measurable impact and adoption.
  

- Familiarity with learning, credentials, talent, or skills ecosystems is desirable but not required.
  

Why Join Us
  


- Influence the evolution of Credly as a global digital credentials platform .
  

- Work on products that sit at the heart of Pearson’s enterprise and partner ecosystem .
  

- Collaborate with experienced teams across product, engineering, and commercial functions.
  

- Make a tangible impact on how skills and credentials are recognised and shared globally.
  

Who we are:
  

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.
  

Pearson is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a member of E-Verify. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other group protected by law. We actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act.
  

If you are an individual with a disability and are unable or limited in your ability to use or access our career site as a result of your disability, you may request reasonable accommodations by emailing TalentExperienceGlobalTeam@grp.pearson.com.

Sibros is accelerating the future of SDV excellence with its Deep Connected Platform™ that orchestrates full vehicle software update management, vehicle analytics, and remote commands in one integrated system. Our Mission

Our mission is to help our customers get the most value out of their connected devices.

Job Title: Product Manager - Core Platform & Infrastructure

Job Type: Full-Time

As a Product Manager for Core Infrastructure at Sibros, you aren't just managing a backlog - you are the architect of the foundational pipeline that connects vehicles to the cloud. You will sit at the intersection of embedded automotive systems, distributed cloud computing, and business strategy. We are looking for a highly technical product leader who can navigate the complex, high-stakes landscape of modern vehicle architectures. - Own the Core Vehicle-to-Cloud Pipeline: Lead the full product lifecycle for our foundational infrastructure products, including OTA orchestration engines and remote command delivery. - Drive Platform Reliability & Scale: Define and track critical platform KPIs (e.g. OTA success rates, command latency, system uptime) and use technical discovery to address architectural bottlenecks proactively.
- Autonomous Decision-Making: Act as the primary authority for your platform infrastructure domain, synthesizing deeply technical constraints and market requirements into a clear, prioritized roadmap without requiring day-to-day tactical guidance.
- Cross-Functional Technical Leadership: Interface with Business Development, Solutions Architecture, and Engineering to translate complex OEM infrastructure requirements into scalable, platform-agnostic solutions that serve diverse vehicle segments.

What you should know

Required Qualifications



- Professional Experience: 5+ years of Product Management experience in high-growth environments, with a proven track record of delivering deeply technical platform products, infrastructure, or middleware at scale.
- Automotive & Mobility Domain Expertise: Strong understanding of the vehicle architecture ecosystem, including telemetry, automotive communication protocols (CAN, Ethernet), and diagnostic standards (UDS, SOVD).

You design with the entire ecosystem in mind, ensuring that changes to the core platform account for, support, and align with upstream OEM workflows, downstream applications, and broader data dependencies.
- Strategic Autonomy: You are a principled, self-directed leader with a history of making high-stakes technical decisions independently. You excel at navigating ambiguity and establishing clear technical directions in a fast-paced environment.
- Technical Communication: Exceptional ability to translate complex architectural constraints and infrastructure concepts into strategic business value for executive stakeholders and OEM partners.

Preferred Qualifications



- Automotive Cybersecurity & Safety Standards: Familiarity with functional safety (ISO 26262), automotive cybersecurity (ISO 21434).
- Engineering Roots: A background in Embedded Software, Cloud Systems Architecture, or Systems Engineering is highly desirable.
- Enterprise Integration: Experience building developer-facing tools, SDKs, or highly flexible APIs used by third-party enterprise engineering groups.

- A dynamic work environment with a flat hierarchy and the opportunity for rapid career advancement.
- Access to continuous learning and development opportunities.
- Flexible working hours to accommodate different time zones.
- Comprehensive benefits package including health insurance and wellness programs.
- A culture that values innovation and promotes a work-life balance.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Vice President, POM Product Owner

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President, POM Product Owner to join our Conventional Data Services Group. This role is located in Pune.

In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:



-  Product strategy & AI Innovation: Define long-term product roadmaps, manage the backlog, and align delivery schedules directly with corporate KPIs, proactively identifying opportunities to integrate AI and automated solutions to drive efficiency. 
-  Requirements Analysis: Lead the elicitation, analysis, and mapping of highly complex enterprise requirements into actionable functional specifications.

-  Documentation & Training Enablement: Author comprehensive, high-quality documentation and design structured training materials to ensure seamless user adoption and operational readiness. 
-  Cross-Functional influence: serve as the strategic liaison between clients, Operations, and Engineering teams. 
-  Agile Governance: Champion rigorous Agile/Scrum standards, ensuring story health, precise acceptance criteria, and optimal development velocity. 

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:



-  Bachelor’s degree in business, Computer Science, Finance, or a related field. 
-  Advanced degree preferred. 
-  5-10 years of professional experience. 
-  Deep mastery of project management tools (JIRA, Confluence). Advanced knowledge of Scrum/Agile frameworks. 
-  Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively as a team player in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well-funded early-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.

Position Summary

The Product Owner is a highly execution-focused role responsible for driving the successful delivery of Gruve's next-generation AI infrastructure platform. Working closely with Product Leadership and Engineering, the Product Owner will translate product strategy, customer requirements, and platform roadmap into clear, prioritized engineering deliverables.

This role requires a strong blend of product ownership, technical understanding, and Agile execution to manage product backlogs, define user stories, and enable the development of enterprise AI platform capabilities across GPU infrastructure, AI control plane, observability, governance, multi-tenancy, and cloud-native services. The ideal candidate is a hands-on Product Owner who can bridge product vision and engineering execution while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams across India and the US.

Key Responsibilities



- Own and manage the Pulse AI product backlog, ensuring alignment with product roadmap and business priorities
- Translate product strategy, customer requirements, and technical inputs into epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and sprint-ready deliverables
- Prioritize features based on customer value, business impact, technical dependencies, and release commitments
- Partner closely with Engineering, Architecture, QA, DevOps, and Product Leadership to drive sprint planning, backlog grooming, release planning, and execution
- Create and maintain Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), functional specifications, workflows, release notes, and product documentation
- Define requirements for AI platform capabilities including GPU resource management, model inference, RAG pipelines, AI governance, observability, cost optimization, and multi-tenant platform features
- Collaborate with engineering teams to validate technical feasibility, resolve execution blockers, and ensure successful feature delivery
- Participate in customer discussions, product demonstrations, proof-of-concept activities, and stakeholder workshops to capture product feedback
- Track product KPIs, feature adoption, release quality, and operational metrics to continuously improve product delivery and user experience

Basic Qualifications



- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline
- 8–12 years of IT experience with at least 5 years as a Product Owner, Technical Product Manager, or similar product ownership role
- Strong experience managing Agile product backlogs, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and product delivery
- Proven ability to write high-quality user stories, acceptance criteria, PRDs, functional specifications, and release documentation
- Good understanding of enterprise software platforms, cloud infrastructure, APIs, microservices, and distributed systems
- Exposure to AI/ML platforms, LLM applications, inference workflows, data pipelines, or enterprise AI platforms
- Experience working closely with Engineering, QA, DevOps, and Architecture teams throughout the software development lifecycle
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work across technical and business teams
- Hands-on experience with Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, ClickUp, Miro, Figma, or similar Agile product management tools
- Strong analytical thinking and prioritization skills with the ability to balance customer needs, business goals, and technical constraints

Preferred Qualifications



- Experience working on AI infrastructure, enterprise AI platforms, GPU-based systems, LLM applications, RAG pipelines, or AI platform products
- Strong understanding of Kubernetes, containerized workloads, platform engineering, observability, DevOps, and CI/CD practices
- Experience with cloud platforms including AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform
- Exposure to NVIDIA AI Enterprise, NVIDIA NIM, NeMo, GPU Operator, or similar AI infrastructure technologies
- Experience in enterprise infrastructure, data center technologies, managed services, cloud platforms, or cybersecurity products
- Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), PSPO, or equivalent Agile certification
- Experience supporting customer demonstrations, Proof of Concepts (PoCs), solution workshops, or enterprise product rollouts
- Prior experience working in startup or high-growth product organizations
- Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to drive execution in fast-paced, cross-functional environments

Enterprise customers rarely come to us with neatly packaged problems. They come with a business goal, a messy process, a bunch of systems that don't talk to each other and a question: "Can AI solve this?"

We’re looking for an AI Product Manager who can sit with our enterprise customers, understand these problems deeply and turn them into AI-powered solutions. You’ll operate at the intersection of strategy, technology, operations and customer conversations, working closely with our product and engineering teams to take solutions from an idea to something that actually works.

This isn't a traditional PM role where you'll spend your days writing PRDs and moving tickets around. You’ll have a front-row seat to some of the most interesting AI use cases emerging in commerce.

What you'll do

- Work directly with enterprise customers to understand their business processes, pain points and goals, and identify opportunities where AI can create meaningful impact.

- Translate ambiguous business problems into AI-led solution strategies, figuring out what should be automated, augmented or redesigned.

- Own the solutioning process from problem discovery to implementation, working closely with engineering, product and customer-facing teams.

- Design workflows and solutions using LLMs, AI agents, automation and BiteSpeed's product capabilities to solve real customer problems.

- Work with enterprise stakeholders to build business cases, define success metrics and communicate the expected impact of proposed solutions.

- Get hands-on with the details when required, whether that's understanding APIs, data flows, system architecture or experimenting with AI tools and prototypes.

- Identify patterns across customer problems and feed those insights back into the product roadmap, helping us decide what should become a scalable product rather than a one-off solution.

- Build repeatable solutioning playbooks, processes and operating mechanisms that help us solve enterprise problems faster as we scale.

- Partner with Sales and Customer Success on strategic accounts, helping them win, onboard and grow enterprise customers through better technical and AI-led solutioning.

- Stay close to the rapidly evolving AI ecosystem and continuously experiment with new models, tools and approaches that could unlock better solutions for our customers.

What makes you a good fit

- You enjoy sitting with a messy problem and figuring out "how would we actually solve this?" rather than waiting for someone to hand you a requirements document.

- You have a strong technical foundation and are comfortable understanding APIs, integrations, data flows and software systems. You don't necessarily need to be a full-time engineer, but you should be technical enough to go deep when the problem demands it.

- You have 3+ years of experience in product, solutions engineering, consulting, technology, strategy & operations or a similar role where you've solved complex business problems.

- You are genuinely curious about AI and LLMs and have experimented with AI tools, agents, workflows or applications beyond simply using ChatGPT to write emails.

- You are comfortable speaking to enterprise customers and senior stakeholders, understanding their problems and explaining technical solutions in simple business language.

- You have strong business judgment and can distinguish between a problem that needs a fancy AI solution and one that just needs a better process.

- You are comfortable operating with ambiguity and high ownership. There won't always be a playbook, and that's kind of the point.

- You care about outcomes more than job titles and enjoy moving between strategy, customer conversations and getting your hands dirty with execution.

- Personal Transformation
- Wealth Creation
- Winning Together

Our Values

Our values are about how we do what we do. Values define the right thing to do. We hire, reward and sometimes have to let go based on our values.

- Go Above And Beyond
- Making Things Happen
- Say It Like It Is
- Progress Over Perfection
- Don’t Take Yourself Seriously, Take Your Work Seriously

- Health Insurance - Health insurance cover and accident coverage for extra cushion and mental peace when rainy days hit us.

- Personal Development - We sponsor courses, conference tickets, books on a case to case basis to ensure we’re constantly growing.

Title: Product Manager / Product Owner Billing & Revenue Cycle**

**Location: India**

**About the Company**

First Insight is a leading healthcare technology company headquartered in Sioux Falls, South Dakota, USA. With more than 30 years of innovation and industry leadership, First Insight serves over 2,000 eye care professionals nationwide through a fully integrated technology platform.

In 1994, First Insight became the first company to introduce a fully integrated EHR, Practice Management, and Optical Management solution specifically designed for optometrists and ophthalmologists helping redefine operational excellence in eye care practices.

Today, our global team of more than 300 professionals operates across the United States and India. Our product ecosystem includes:

- MaximEyes Industry-leading EHR, Practice Management, and Optical Software
- Fast Pay Health Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) and Billing Services
- EVAA AI-powered workflow automation and intelligence platform

We are committed to improving patient outcomes, increasing practice efficiency, and driving financial performance for healthcare providers through innovative technology and exceptional service.

Join a company that combines deep healthcare expertise, cutting-edge technology, and a mission-driven culture focused on transforming eye care.

To learn more, visit: www.first-insight.com

**Job Summary**

The Product Manager / Product Owner Billing & Revenue Cycle will own and continuously improve the billing capabilities of MaximEyes, First Insight’s EHR and Practice Management System, while also playing a key product role in EVAA Billing Assistant, the company’s AI- and RPA-powered billing automation platform.The role will have a strong mandate to harness AI and intelligent automation to make billing workflows faster, more accurate, more predictive, and increasingly touchless.

This is a highly hands-on product role requiring deep expertise in the U.S. healthcare billing lifecycle, preferably within optometry and ophthalmology. The successful candidate will identify billing product issues, define solutions, write detailed requirements, work closely with engineering and QA, validate fixes, and continuously look for opportunities to use AI, automation, workflow intelligence, and data-driven decisioning to eliminate manual work and improve billing outcomes.

The role will also help build EVAA Billing Assistant into a scalable, AI-first automation platform capable of integrating with MaximEyes and other leading eye-care EHR/PMS platforms used in the market. The goal is to automate as much of the end-to-end billing lifecycle as practical while retaining appropriate human oversight for exceptions and high-risk decisions.

The ideal candidate combines deep billing subject-matter expertise with EHR/PMS product management, product ownership, healthcare workflow knowledge, and a strong understanding of how AI, RPA, APIs, intelligent agents, and workflow automation can be applied to healthcare billing.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Own and maintain the billing product roadmap for MaximEyes and related First Insight products, prioritizing enhancements based on customer impact, revenue impact, operational efficiency, regulatory requirements, strategic importance, and the opportunity to leverage AI and automation to remove repetitive work.

- Serve as the primary billing subject-matter expert and product owner for MaximEyes, with deep knowledge of patient registration, insurance, eligibility, benefits, authorization, charge capture, coding, claims, clearinghouse workflows, rejections, denials, corrections, secondary billing, coordination of benefits, payment posting, ERA/EOB, patient responsibility, adjustments, refunds, A/R, aging, follow-up, unused benefits, reconciliation, statements, and reporting.

- Investigate complex billing problems, reproduce product defects, determine root cause, and define systemic product solutions rather than one-off workarounds.

- Work directly with engineering, QA, AI/ML, and automation teams to define requirements, acceptance criteria, business rules, workflow specifications, test scenarios, and release validation for billing functionality, including AI-assisted and automated workflows.

- Own the product development of EVAA Billing Assistant, including eligibility verification, benefits verification, unused benefits verification, claim preparation and submission, claim-status checking, rejection handling, claim correction and resubmission, payment posting, ERA/EOB processing, reconciliation, A/R workflows, denials, and automated follow-up, with a focus on maximizing the percentage of these activities that can be intelligently automated.

- Determine which billing processes should be automated using AI, intelligent agents, RPA, rules-based automation, APIs, or a combination of technologies. Define where AI can interpret information, make recommendations or decisions, predict outcomes, detect anomalies, and initiate actions, while establishing appropriate human-in-the-loop controls, auditability, and exception-handling processes.

- Build a practical AI-first product strategy for billing: identify repetitive, rules-heavy, data-heavy, and exception-driven workflows that can be transformed into intelligent agents and automated processes; define measurable targets for touchless processing, accuracy, cycle time, and revenue impact; and continuously learn from production data to improve automation.

- Work with engineering, AI/ML, and integration teams to design EVAA integrations across MaximEyes, RevolutionEHR, Compulink, OfficeMate, Eyefinity, ModMed, Acuity Logic, and other relevant EHR/PMS platforms, using APIs, automation, AI agents, and other integration methods wherever practical.

- Understand how billing data flows between EHR/PMS systems, clearinghouses, payers, RCM platforms, payment systems, and EVAA, and translate those workflows into scalable product requirements that enable AI-driven data extraction, validation, workflow orchestration, exception detection, and automated action.

- Participate in customer discovery with practice administrators, billers, RCM professionals, physicians, and practice owners to identify real-world billing pain points and determine where AI and automation can deliver measurable improvements in productivity, accuracy, collections, and user experience.

- Create and maintain PRDs, epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, workflow diagrams, and product backlogs; participate in sprint planning, refinement, demos, retrospectives, and release planning.

- Partner closely with Engineering, QA, Product, UX/UI, AI/ML, RPA/automation, Implementation, Customer Support, RCM, Sales, Marketing, and Executive Leadership, acting as the functional authority on billing and the product champion for intelligent automation across the billing lifecycle.

- Maintain current knowledge of U.S. healthcare billing practices, payer requirements, electronic claims, clearinghouses, coding and reimbursement rules, Medicare and commercial payer workflows, denials, coordination of benefits, HIPAA-related considerations, and other applicable healthcare requirements.

- Continuously evaluate competing EHR/PMS and RCM billing capabilities, AI-enabled healthcare solutions, and emerging automation technologies, and identify opportunities for MaximEyes and EVAA to deliver superior billing functionality, intelligent automation, and differentiated AI-powered workflows.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

- 3-5 years of relevant experience in healthcare billing, revenue cycle management, EHR/PMS, healthcare IT, or healthcare software.
- Significant hands-on experience with U.S. healthcare insurance billing, preferably in optometry, ophthalmology, or another physician-practice environment.
- Deep understanding of the end-to-end medical/vision billing lifecycle.
- Proven experience working with an EHR or Practice Management System.
- Strong understanding of eligibility, benefits, claims, claim submission, rejections, denials, payment posting, ERA/EOB, A/R, and insurance workflows.
- Experience translating complex billing workflows into software requirements, including requirements for AI-enabled workflows, automation, decision engines, integrations, and working with engineering and QA teams in an Agile/Scrum product environment.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to investigate complex product issues, determine root cause, evaluate where AI or automation can solve the underlying problem, and measure the resulting business impact.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Strong understanding of U.S. healthcare workflows and payer processes.

**Preferred Qualifications**

- Experience specifically with optometry or ophthalmology billing.
- Experience with one or more eye-care EHR/PMS platforms such as MaximEyes, RevolutionEHR, Compulink, OfficeMate, Eyefinity, ModMed, Acuity Logic, or similar systems.
- Experience as a Product Manager, Product Owner, Business Analyst, Billing SME, RCM Manager, or EHR implementation specialist, preferably with ownership of AI-enabled or automated healthcare workflows.
- Experience building or implementing healthcare billing automation, intelligent workflows, AI agents, RPA, or other technologies designed to reduce manual revenue-cycle work.
- Experience with AI, generative AI, AI agents, RPA, workflow automation, intelligent decisioning, machine learning, or other automation technologies, with an understanding of how to apply them responsibly in healthcare workflows.
- Experience working with APIs and third-party integrations.
- Experience with clearinghouses and electronic claims.
- Experience with healthcare payment processing.
- Experience working with healthcare SaaS products.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

Job Summary

The Aveva Wonderware Product Owner at ENGIE India is the key interface between the business needs of the Global Hypervision Center (GHC) in Paris and the feature team responsible for the deployment and evolution of the Aveva Wonderware-based solution. This role ensures that the team delivers high-quality software aligned with ENGIE’s standards, business objectives, and the global product vision. The Product Owner coordinates requirements gathering, backlog management, and delivery planning, and acts as the primary point of contact for stakeholders, including the global Product Owner and R&F GBU Digital & IT teams.

Main Objectives



- Act as the liaison between the GHC business (client) and the feature team, translating business needs into actionable requirements and specifications.
- Coordinate the definition, development, and production of new software versions, ensuring quality, cost, and time objectives are met.
- Maintain alignment with ENGIE’s global product strategy and ensure consistency between the GHC and other ENGIE ROCCs worldwide.
- Manage the feature team backlog using tools such as Azure DevOps and plan deliveries for upcoming sprints and releases.
- Communicate regularly with the global Product Owner and other stakeholders to report progress, highlight risks, and propose enhancements.

Key Responsibilities



- Collect requirements from the head of the GHC and other stakeholders; write and maintain general and detailed specifications.
- Highlight risks, dependencies, and challenges, and proactively manage them with relevant parties.
- Plan and prioritize deliveries for sprints and upcoming months, ensuring clear communication of goals and timelines.
- Define detailed specifications, including inputs/outputs, mockups, and tasks for the development team.
- Coordinate the feature team’s activities, ensuring effective collaboration and agile delivery.
- Oversee testing, production deployment, and training activities.
- Ensure the team integrates into a dynamic, agile project environment and collaborates effectively with large, international teams.
- Facilitate the handover and knowledge transfer from the R&F Digital&IT team in France.
- Travel to France (Lyon or Paris) as required for team synchronization and handover activities.

Experience & Qualifications



- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.
- Minimum of 5 years of experience in product ownership, project management, or similar roles in OT/SCADA/hypervision environments.
- Proven experience in managing software projects in the renewable energy or industrial automation sector is an advantage.
- Experience working with Aveva Wonderware System Platform, OMI, and related technologies is a plus.

Technical Skills



- Advanced expertise in OT project management (hypervision, SCADA, etc.) – mandatory, highest priority.
- Familiarity with Aveva Wonderware System Platform, OMI, and Aveva Unified Operation Center (UOC) is desirable.
- Understanding of data historization (Aveva Historian) and industrial protocols (MQTT, OPC, Modbus, etc.) is a plus.
- Experience with Agile methodologies (SCRUM, KANBAN) and backlog management tools (e.g., Azure DevOps).

Other Skills & Abilities



- Advanced proficiency in English (mandatory); French is an advantage.
- Strong communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.
- Ability to work collaboratively in large, dynamic, and multicultural teams.
- Customer-focused, with a commitment to delivering high-quality solutions.
- Adaptable to changing priorities and able to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

Behavioral Competencies



- Strong leadership and decision-making abilities.
- Excellent organizational and planning skills.
- Ability to manage ambiguity and drive clarity in complex environments.
- Commitment to ENGIE’s values and mission for a carbon-neutral world.

As the Aveva Wonderware Product Owner at ENGIE, you will play a pivotal role in advancing the digital transformation of a global leader in energy and sustainability. Role Overview 
MyOperator is building AI-driven conversational surfaces — chatbots and voicebots that handle real business conversations, run structured journeys, pull from knowledge bases, and hand off to human agents when needed. We're looking for a Product Manager to own this domain: someone who genuinely understands how LLMs and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems work, and can turn that understanding into product decisions — what to build, which model tradeoffs to make, and how to know if a chatbot or voicebot is actually working.


This is a technical AI product role. You'll be defining journeys, knowledge base behavior, and evaluation criteria for systems where outputs are probabilistic, not deterministic — so the ability to reason about model behavior, failure modes, and retrieval quality matters as much as classic product skills.


About MyOperator
MyOperator is a Business AI Operator platform that allows businesses, teams, and AI Agents to work in tandem for customer operations, i.e., handle Sales, Support, Escalation, Feedback, and Refund processes. With over 12,000+ businesses using our platform, we are the largest in the space.


MyOperator is built for people who want to work on ambitious problems at a meaningful scale. We value ownership, speed, critical thinking, and a bias for building things that create real customer and business outcomes. This is a high-expectation, high-learning environment where people are trusted to think independently, challenge ideas openly, move with urgency, and keep raising the bar as we build for long-term impact.


Key Responsibility Areas

- Own the conversational AI product roadmap — chatbot and voicebot journeys, knowledge base/RAG behavior, and model selection — writing specs that account for real LLM behavior and failure modes, not just ideal-case flows.
- Define and maintain how success is measured — partner with engineering to build and evolve eval systems that track quality (accuracy, containment, hallucination rate) so every release has a clear bar to clear.


Requirements — Must Have

- Strong practical understanding of how LLMs work — prompting, context windows, tool/function calling, and their real-world limitations in production systems.
- Solid understanding of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems — how retrieval, embeddings, and knowledge bases feed into model responses, and where these systems typically break down.
- Working knowledge of the AI model landscape — tradeoffs between models on cost, latency, and accuracy — and how to translate that into build/model-selection decisions for a product.
- Demonstrated ability to write specs for AI-driven product surfaces (chatbot/voicebot journeys, escalation/handover logic) that explicitly account for probabilistic model behavior and edge cases.
- 4+ years as a Product Manager, with meaningful hands-on time owning an AI/LLM-powered product end to end.


Requirements — Good to Have

- Hands-on background building or shipping chatbots or voicebots — design, integrations, and deployment.
- Experience designing conversational journeys — structured, multi-step dialogue or task flows for chat or voice agents.
- Experience building or defining eval systems/frameworks to measure chatbot or voicebot success (e.g., accuracy, containment rate, hallucination rate).
- Familiarity with prompt engineering and iterating on prompts/journeys based on eval results.
- Experience designing human-handover or escalation flows between a bot and a live agent.

Microsoft 365 Core is building the Copilot Connectors \- the foundation that enables Microsoft 365 Copilot and agentic experiences to discover, understand, and act across enterprise data and applications. Our vision is to make every relevant enterprise system accessible to Copilot through a consistent, secure, and governed platform, while preserving source permissions, organizational controls, and user trust.


We are looking for a highly technical **Principal Product Manager** to define and drive the next generation of this platform. You will operate at the intersection of product leadership, systems architecture, platform strategy, developer experience, and ecosystem development. You will partner with engineering leaders, architects, security experts, and product teams across Microsoft to shape how first\-party, partner, and customer\-built connectors are developed, onboarded, managed, discovered, and used across Copilot experiences.

You will also influence investments across multiple organizations to establish common contracts, governance models, and platform capabilities for connecting Copilot to enterprise systems at hyperscale.


This role requires deep technical credibility, solid product intuition, customer obsession, and the ability to align senior leaders across organizations around a shared product and architectural vision.


Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. * Simplify administrator experiences for connector deployment, application provisioning, authentication, permissions, synchronization, governance, health monitoring, and compliance.
* Establish platform contracts and architectural patterns for authentication, identity, permission enforcement, data synchronization, schema mapping, retrieval, tool invocation, and action execution.
* Define the strategy for hybrid connectors that combine tenant\-level synchronization with real\-time, user\-authorized access and actions.
* Create intuitive, scalable developer experiences \- including SDKs, APIs, tools, documentation, samples, and validation frameworks \- for first\-party teams, partners, independent software vendors, and enterprise developers.
* Grow a healthy connector ecosystem by reducing time to build and publish connectors, improving quality, and enabling partners to reach customers across Microsoft Copilot experiences.

* Define how connector data and tools are grounded, ranked, cited, and invoked so Copilot delivers relevant, accurate, and explainable outcomes.

* Build deep partnerships with senior technical leaders and executives to establish a shared vision for connecting Copilot and agents to enterprise systems.
* Mentor product managers and technical leaders while establishing solid product, architectural, and operational practices across the organization.

* **Microsoft Cloud Background Check:** This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

* Bachelor's Degree AND 10\+ years of experience in product/service/program management, software development, or an equivalent technical discipline.

* 8\+ years of experience taking a platform, product, feature, or developer experience from strategy through design, implementation, launch, and adoption.
* 8\+ years of experience improving measurable product outcomes, such as customer adoption, developer velocity, engagement, reliability, retention, or ecosystem growth.

* Experience designing products that serve multiple personas, including end users, administrators, developers, partners, and independent software vendors.

* Solid understanding of platform reliability, observability, lifecycle management, compatibility, and versioning.
* Demonstrated ability to build an ecosystem strategy and work with external partners to deliver high\-quality integrations.
* Solid empathy for developers and customers, with a track record of working backward from their needs.

The Product Manager owns the entire product lifecycle, from conceptualization to obsolescence, defining what to build by translating market and customer needs into solutions that deliver profitable growth and competitive differentiation. As an Engineering Manager you will be an innovative Generative AI Engineer to drive adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) and agentic flows, focusing on process efficiencies, automation, simplification and risk reduction across enterprise business solutions.

To be a successful Engineering Manager, you should have experience with:

- Own product vision, roadmap, backlog, and value delivery.
- Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and data to improve customer and business outcomes.
- Translate business challenges into AI-enabled product requirements.
- Work closely with stakeholders, engineers, designers, and data scientists to deliver solutions.
- Create user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritisation frameworks.
- Prototype and experiment using AI tools, agents, copilots, and automation platforms.
- Measure product performance, adoption, and business impact.
- Ensure solutions align with governance, security, and Responsible AI principles.
- Proven experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Digital Product Lead.
- Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, AI Agents, RAG, and workflow automation.
- Hands-on experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, Azure AI, or similar platforms.
- Strong commercial mindset with a focus on customer value and business outcomes.
- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
- Comfortable working in Agile environments and driving rapid experimentation.

Additional Relevant Skills Given Below Are Highly Valued

- Business-first thinker with an AI-native mindset.
- Curious, hands-on, and passionate about emerging technologies.
- Able to bridge strategy, technology, and execution.
- Outcome-focused, pragmatic, and driven by measurable value.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role is based in Bangalore.

Purpose of the role

The purpose of a Product Owner is to maximize the value of the product by defining a clear product vision (are they setting the vision or would this align to ), managing authoring, refining and prioritizing the Product Backlog balancing trade-offs across desirability, viability and feasibility – making sure the right thing is being ‘built’, and prioritising work based on business goals. They act as the primary liaison between stakeholders and delivery teams, ensuring the product meets user/customer needs and delivers optimal value. Product Owners are responsible for developing a roadmap and driving execution of their product area/sub-journey, applying continuous improvement principles and techniques.

Accountabilities

- Ensure Product Alignment with Business Goals: Ensure that the product & its features are aligned with broader objectives, driving value and contributing to the organization’s overall strategy. Utilisation of market research, analysis of customer feedback and monitoring of industry trends to identify new products, features or enhancements. 
- Communicate Product Vision to Delivery Teams: Clearly articulate the product vision and goals to the delivery teams, ensuring they understand, align and are inspired to deliver the business value and purpose of each feature or user story.
- Create and Refine User Stories: Write clear, concise user stories with detailed acceptance criteria, refining them as needed to ensure the development team has all the necessary information to implement features successfully.
- Agile Events: Participate in key Agile events such as sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives to keep the team aligned and focused on delivering the product backlog.
- Managing the Product Backlog: Responsible for creating, maintaining, and prioritising the product backlog, ensuring the highest value features are delivered first, based on business needs, customer requirements and organisational impacts, balancing risk migration and future proofing against the product strategy.
- Act as the Voice of the Customer: Continuously gather feedback from customers and end-users to understand their pain points and ensure that the product meets their needs and improves their overall experience.
- Acceptance Criteria Definition & Management: Review and accept or reject work completed by the development team during sprints, ensuring that all delivered features meet the agreed-upon acceptance criteria and deliver business value.
- Collaborate with Stakeholders: Work closely with stakeholders (e.g., customers, business leaders, and marketing teams) to gather requirements, define product goals, and ensure that the product vision aligns with business objectives.
- Monitor Product Performance and Iterate: Regularly assess product performance using KPIs and customer feedback, adjusting the product backlog and roadmap to improve functionality and meet evolving customer needs. Manage on-going readiness and 'run' activities of live products including monitoring, governance and approvals.
- Risk and Control: Managing risk, including identification of potential risks, development of strategies to resolve or mitigate and escalate as necessary those risks, and alignment between the product management and control functions.

Vice President Expectations

- To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
- If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
- If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
- OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
- Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
- Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
- Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
- Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
- Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
- Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
- Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
- Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. Technical Product Manager

Function: Product

Location: India (Remote)

Reporting: Sr Director - Product

The Role

Scrut is building the AI-native future of GRC - autonomous agents, headless APIs, an MCP server, and agentic workflows replacing what was historically manual, click-through work.

We're hiring a Technical Product Manager to own the strategy and roadmap for the modules you'll lead, sitting at the intersection of engineering, AI, and the compliance domain. This is a role for a seasoned PM who operates independently from day one. The bar is high on both technical depth and AI-native fluency - and we test for both.

What You'll Do

- Own strategy and roadmap for your modules, end-to-end - from discovery and requirements through launch and iteration. Influence prioritization based on business impact, technical feasibility, and customer value.
- Write specs engineers build from without ambiguity - PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria covering API contracts, data models, integration logic, webhooks, and workflow rule sets.
- Shape the architecture conversation - evaluate feasibility and trade-offs early; hold your own on system design, service boundaries, and scalability rather than just facilitating.
- Work AI-natively - use AI-driven development tools (Claude, Cursor, Codex) daily for prototyping, spec-writing, and validating technical approaches.
- Instrument everything you ship - define the event taxonomy and success metrics before launch; use funnels, cohorts, and adoption data to decide what to double down on and what to kill. Bring data and judgment in equal measure.
- Champion the customer at every stage - scope and synthesize prospect and customer feedback, define market needs clearly, and map them to actionable product features.

- Listen to customer requirements and convert them into clear product workflows, implementation plans, and feature requests.

- Document everything that matters: use cases, customer feedback, gaps, and expansion opportunities.

- Coordinate with our Sales, Product, Development, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth, successful implementations.
- Configure solutions, train customers, and support adoption so they actually see the value they were promised.
- Be the voice of the customer internally and the voice of the product externally.

**Grow Accounts & Identify Opportunities**

- Once a customer is live, you'll identify where they can use more of the platform—new modules, integrations, additional automation workflows.
- Recommend expansions based on their actual business needs and evolving challenges.

- Keep current on product features, AI capabilities, and automation trends so you can confidently speak about what's possible.
- Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation and demo environments.
- Use AI tools to create proposals, workflows, and supporting materials that help close deals and launch implementations.

- 3+ years in B2B SaaS, Product Management, Technical Presales, Solution Consulting, or SaaS Implementation.
- Proven ability to conduct software product demonstrations confidently.
- Experience translating business requirements into technical solutions.
- Working knowledge of at least one of: CRM, APIs, SaaS integrations, business automation workflows, or customer onboarding.
- Excellent communication skills—you can explain technical concepts to non-technical founders and detail workflows to engineers.
- Comfort working with founders, CXOs, and senior decision-makers (not just department heads).
- Self-directed: you manage multiple customer requirements independently and take ownership end-to-end.

**Nice to Have**

- Experience with AI-powered solutions or AI calling platforms.
- Familiarity with CRM platforms, WhatsApp Business API, chatbots, or email automation.
- Background in marketing automation or lead-management systems.
- Understanding of API integrations and technical implementation workflows.
- Experience with customer onboarding at scale.

- You're genuinely interested in customer problems, not just closing deals.
- You can balance being consultative with being straightforward about what we can and can't do.
- You thrive in a fast-paced environment where you own multiple moving pieces.
- You see feedback (from customers or the team) as useful input, not criticism.
- You're curious about AI and automation but pragmatic about real-world business needs.

Complete customer journey from initial discovery through successful implementation and adoption.

Product demonstrations for multiple industries and use cases.

Coordination across teams (Sales, Product, Support, Customer Success, Development).

Solution design and configuration for customer requirements.

Customer feedback, feature requests, and product improvement recommendations.

Account expansion opportunities and cross-sell recommendations.

Documentation, demo environments, and team enablement.

- Opportunity to shape product direction through direct customer feedback.
- Fast-paced, collaborative environment with a lean, high-impact team.
- Chance to build expertise across AI, CRM, automation, and business processes.

- No politics or endless meetings—work focused on outcomes.
- Your ideas matter: customer feedback directly influences product roadmap.
- Solve real problems for real businesses, not toy projects.

**Adoption \& Performance Metrics:** Drive continuous KPI improvements for high\-impact capabilities, including digital adoption metrics and secure adoption of AI
  
**Cross\-Functional Leadership:** Drive alignment across a diverse network of internal and external teams—including functional product managers, IT, AI , engineering, UI/UX design, analytics, sales, marketing, and external support agencies.

**Launch \& Release Management:** Maintain ultimate accountability for all development and operations activities, spanning partner coordination, pre\-production readiness, and seamless enterprisewide product deployments.
  
**Effective use of AI tools:** Leverage AI tools to automate workflows, basic prompt engineering, streamlining internal processes

Digital Journey Mapping and Optimisation

About Company

Certree's purpose is to safeguard data privacy and eliminate fraud by empowering individuals to have ownership of their own data.

Certree is a document anti-fraud and data security company. Our zero-trust technology ensures that only the individual owner of the data can see it or share it from their vault. Certree's technology also guarantees the authenticity of documents shared directly by individuals, and therefore eliminates the need for organizations to send or sell sensitive employee and student personal data to third party data brokers for verification purposes (such as verification of an individual's education, income or employment history), a very common practice today and often without the individual's awareness.

Since launching in early 2021, Certree has been rapidly adopted by tens of thousands of organizations to protect millions of their employees and students. We are quickly disintermediating data brokers as middlemen in our daily life.

We’re looking for a passionate and entrepreneurial Product Manager to join our team. If you’re excited by the idea of wearing multiple hats, owning the product lifecycle, and making a tangible impact, this is the role for you.

Key Responsibilities

Product Vision & Strategy: Partner with the founding team to shape and evolve the product vision, aligning with our mission and growth objectives.

Customer-Centric Innovation: Spend time understanding user needs through direct conversations, surveys, and data analysis to drive product decisions.

Launch & Learn: Manage product launches, gather feedback, and iterate to ensure the product delivers value and delight to users.

Startup Mindset: Thrives in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and embraces the opportunity to wear multiple hats.

Experience: 2 - 6 years in product management roles, ideally in a startup or SaaS environment.

Education: B.E. / B.Tech / M.Tech in Computer Science or Engineering from Tier 1 Institutes.

Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills to articulate ideas, influence stakeholders, and align teams.

Entrepreneurial Spirit: A self-starter who takes ownership and can turn ideas into action with minimal direction.

Customer Empathy: Passionate about solving real problems for users and continuously improving customer experience.

Technical Acumen: Able to work closely with engineers and understand technical trade-offs. Coding skills are a plus but not required.

Product Implementation: Experience in a hands-on role with Product implementation is a plus.

Agility: Comfortable with lean product development and rapid iteration to test hypotheses and validate ideas.

Toolset: Familiarity with tools like JIRA, Trello, Figma, and analytics platforms like Elastic.

A high-growth, VC-backed SaaS company hiring its founding India product team

Preferred Qualifications


- Experience with analytics tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, or SQL

- Familiarity with a startup or zero-to-one environment

What We Offer


- A founding product seat with a high-growth SaaS company
- Remote-friendly, pan-India hiring with long-term placement
- High ownership and direct influence on the roadmap
- One application considered for this and future matched roles

Employment Type: Full-time
About the Role
We are seeking an experienced E-Invoicing Product Owner / Technical Product Owner to drive the product strategy, roadmap, and delivery of global e-invoicing and digital tax compliance platforms. In this role, you will be the bridge between business stakeholders (Finance, Tax, Operations) and technical engineering teams, translating complex international regulatory mandates into actionable product roadmaps and user stories.
You will play a pivotal role in establishing and scaling our Global E-Invoicing Centre of Expertise (COE), driving agile execution, vendor coordination, and seamless country rollouts.
Key Responsibilities

- Product Roadmap & Strategy: Define, prioritize, and maintain the multi-year global e-invoicing product vision, release roadmaps, and feature backlogs.
- Agile Product Delivery: Act as the dedicated Product Owner for engineering teams—authoring epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and managing sprint priorities in Agile/Scrum ceremonies.
- Regulatory & Compliance Translation: Translate complex international tax mandates (e.g., Peppol, Continuous Transaction Controls / CTC, EU ViDA) into clear functional and technical product requirements.
- COE Scaling & Best Practices: Partner with architects and program leads to establish standard operating frameworks, rollout playbooks, and best practices across the Global E-Invoicing COE.
- Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with Global Tax, Finance, Accounts Payable (P2P), Accounts Receivable (O2C), and IT leadership to ensure alignment on delivery milestones and scope.
- Vendor & Platform Governance: Coordinate with external compliance service providers and platform vendors (e.g., Sovos, Pagero, SAP DRC, Tungsten) for feature delivery, SLAs, and technical enhancements.
- User Adoption & Enablement: Oversee UAT, cutover planning, business enablement, and operational transition for country-by-country go-lives.
Qualifications & Requirements

- Experience: 8+ years of total experience, including substantial experience as a Product Owner / Technical Product Manager leading enterprise financial systems, billing, or compliance platforms.
- Functional Domain: Strong working knowledge of core finance cycles: Order-to-Cash (O2C), Procure-to-Pay / Invoice-to-Pay (P2P/I2P), and Record-to-Report (R2R).
- Technical & Integration Literacy: Solid understanding of SAP finance modules, API-driven workflows, EDI standards, and electronic invoice formats (XML, UBL, JSON).
- Agile Mastery: Proven track record in backlog grooming, user story definition, sprint planning, and release governance in multi-team enterprise environments.
- Communication & Leadership: Exceptional stakeholder management, cross-functional collaboration, and communication skills across business, technical, and executive groups.
Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on product experience with platforms such as SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) / eDocument, Sovos, Pagero, Avalara, or Tungsten Network.
- Strong domain exposure to Peppol networks, real-time clearance models (CTC), and emerging regulations like EU ViDA (VAT in the Digital Age).
- Relevant certifications: Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), SAFe PO/PM, or equivalent.

 Gen AI Native   Multi-Domain  Compliance   Strategic + Executional

We are looking for a dynamic, self-starter Product Manager to lead product initiatives across Compliance verticals. Compliance Vertical

Must-Have Requirements

WHAT WE OFFER


Working at the Intersection of Mission and Scale

- Ownership of two verticals from Day 1 — high visibility, high impact.
- Collaborative culture: work alongside a strong existing PM team in Education.
- Exposure to AI-first product development practices across the portfolio.
- Competitive compensation with performance-linked growth trajectory.
- Opportunity to shape products used by thousands of students, faculty, and compliance professionals globally.


ABOUT OUR SECTORS


Compliance Sector
Providing regulatory, document control, and accreditation software for industries with strict oversight — including chemical compliance (Ithos), QMS (DocXellent), pharmacy education (McCreadie Group), and ERP with compliance (Blue Link).
